student_learning_goal: I can make a two-way tally table.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can make a two-way tally table.
header.character_watermark: Tally with a clipboard in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Read the table. Find row totals and column totals.
parts.visual_layout: Pre-built 2x2 table with tally marks. Headers show APPLE / COOKIE columns. Below: 4 questions about the apple totals.

image_placeholders.description: A pre-built 2-way tally table for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Headers: top columns 'APPLE' / 'COOKIE'; left rows 'MILK' / 'WATER'. Cells filled with tally marks: apple+milk = ||||CROSS, apple+water = |||, cookie+milk = ||, cookie+water = ||||. Below the table, 4 questions: 'How many chose apple+milk?' '... cookie+milk?' '... apple total?' '... milk total?'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P1_TABLE at Part 1: instructions ask the child to read totals. Keywords name the visual elements.

parts.answer_key: Apple+Milk = 5. Cookie+Milk = 2. Apple total = 5+3 = 8. Milk total = 5+2 = 7.

parts.student_instructions: Survey 6 classmates with 2 questions. Tally in the table.

image_placeholders.description: A blank 2x2 tally table for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Top: 'Question 1: ___' line. Left side: 'Question 2: ___' line. 4 cells with thin borders, each ~2in × 1.5in. Total area below for row + column totals.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P2_BLANK at Part 2: instructions ask the child to build a 2-way table. Keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any valid 2-question survey of 6 classmates with consistent tallies.

parts.student_instructions: Make your own 2-way survey at home (3 family members).
parts.visual_layout: A blank 2-way tally table for home survey, with question lines for the two questions and 4 cells for tallying answers.

image_placeholders.description: A blank 2-way tally table for a Grade 2 worksheet, similar to Part 2 but smaller (~3 row total). Designed for home use with 3 family members.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P3_HOME at Part 3: instructions ask for home survey. Keywords name the focus.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write 2 questions about your 2-way table.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Use Part 2 for formative — single-tally per child in correct cell.
